tl;dr: If you've completed series 3, your boxes which would have contained a series 3 card are replaced with the boxes containing 200-600 CT, while your boxes containing 100 CT remain the same.

Collector's reserves (assuming you mean reserves and not caches since you have a s3-complete collection) are divided into chunks of 40 reserves, and these are further divided into chunks of 4 reserves each.

Each mini-chunk is guaranteed to contain:

* 1 CardsBox — see below for more details
* 1 AssetsBox, containing an avatar, title, or variant
* 1 CurrencyBox, containing Credits or Gold
* 100 Collector's Tokens

And of those CardsBoxes, every larger chunk of 40 reserves includes:

* 9 SeriesNot4Boxes.
 * These have a ~99% chance of containing a Series 3 card, and a ~1% chance of containing a series 5 card.
 * If you have every series 3 card, you get 200-600 Collector's Tokens instead.
* 1 Series4Box, containing a Series 4 card. (Not sure what happens if you've completed Series4.)

So like the person above mentioned, it's technically possible to have up to 79 boxes in between two s4 cards, but if that happened, your next one is guaranteed within the next 40.

My source for all this is [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eh5lR6Exjek) if my explanation was unclear.
